exposure: Abdominal entry method (caesarean tubectomy, minilaparotomy, laparoscopic sterilization)
outcome: Immediate complications of female sterilization methods
cohort: Women who underwent sterilization at a tertiary care center in Hubli, Karnataka, India, between January 2010 and December 2014
finding: There was an increasing trend in caesarean tubectomy and laparoscopic sterilization for female sterilization, with caesarean tubectomy and laparoscopic sterilization being associated with a higher risk of complications compared to minilaparotomy.
mod_finding: Caesarean tubectomy was the most common method of sterilization during the puerperal period.
